verdict.rationale: Replit documents scheduled routines that run on a recurring schedule and report back, which is unattended automation inside the product. It also documents a Replit MCP Server that lets an external client create, inspect, or update Replit Apps without the Replit UI. There is no evidence of a CLI, a CI pipeline integration, or a public REST/OpenAPI interface (the probe found no OpenAPI spec), and in-product background tasks are not headless execution. Missing for 10: a documented headless CLI or runner, CI integration (e.g. GitHub Actions), a programmatic API for triggering Agent runs, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Turn a recurring job into a routine that runs on a schedule and reports back to you.
Connect a compatible client to the Replit MCP Server to create, find, inspect, or update Replit Apps from that client.
